column2: [Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has generously decided to send you a skilled physician from [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetHerHis] court. [cathayan_doctor.GetDynName] will serve you well.
Send my most sincere gratitude to the [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle].
§Y[cathayan_doctor.GetDynName]§! appears at your court.
Anything to please the [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle].

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has graciously accepted your gift. The generosity of the [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] dynasty will not be forgotten.
May there forever be harmony between the houses of [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetOnlyDynastyName] and [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName].

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has decided that there shall be no war and strife between our two nations. [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetHerHisCap] infinite mercy and wisdom is an inspiration to us all.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], sends [From.GetHerHisCap] sincerest regards and accepts your pledge of allegiance. May the bond between our two nations last for all time.
I am but a humble servant of the [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle].

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has generously granted your request. The sage scholar-bureaucrat [cathayan_administrator.GetDynName] will join your court. [cathayan_administrator.GetHerHisCap] administrative skills will serve you well.
§Y[cathayan_administrator.GetDynName]§! appears at your court.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has generously granted your request. The master engineer [cathayan_master_engineer.GetDynName] will enlighten your nation.
§Y[cathayan_master_engineer.GetDynName]§! appears at your court.

A fireworks guild has been built in §Y[jd_build_province.GetName]§! by Master Engineer §Y[From.GetDynName]§!.
A dry dock has been built in §Y[jd_build_province.GetName]§! by Master Engineer §Y[From.GetDynName]§!.

§Y[cathayan_strategist.GetDynName]§! appears at your court.

§Y[commander_teacher.GetDynName]§! has been teaching your commander §Y[commander_student.GetTitledFirstName]§! about Cathayan strategy. §Y[commander_student.GetTitledFirstName]§! gains the trait §Y'Way of the Dragon'§!.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetShortCathayanEmperorName] has decided to grant the house of [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] the greatest honor. [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetHerHisCap] daughter, the [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] Princess [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetFirstName], will become the bride of [imperial_marriage_spouse_1.GetTitledFirstName].

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetShortCathayanEmperorName] has decided to grant the house of [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] a great honor. [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetHerHisCap] nephew, the [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] Prince [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetFirstName], will become the groom of [imperial_marriage_spouse_1.GetTitledFirstName].
We are honored. The arrival of [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetPrincessPrince] [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetFirstName] is much awaited.
§Y[imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetDynName]§! is on [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetHerHis] way to the upcoming wedding and will arrive in a few weeks' time.
Becoming your [Root.GetHusbandWife] is a great honor, [From.GetTitledFirstName].
A Divine Union

Everyone is amazed by the arrival of the imperial [From.GetPrincessPrince], [From.GetHerHis] [From.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] highness [From.GetDynName]. Not that [From.GetSheHe] has not been expected – the court in [Root.Capital.GetName] has been busy with the preparations for weeks – no, they are simply astounded by the grandeur of [From.GetHerHis] procession. While those standing close to you begin to whisper about the silk banners and the gleaming armor of the imperial soldiers, you have your sight trained on the intricately decorated litter approaching, holding your future [From.GetHusbandWife].\n\n[From.GetPrincessPrince] [From.GetFirstName]'s eyes are cast low as [From.GetSheHe] exits to greet you, but for the shortest moment they dart up to meet yours. The tiniest of smiles plays at the corners of [From.GetHerHis] mouth, and a soft blush tints [From.GetHerHis] cheeks. The sight is a balm to your frayed nerves. Surely, you can make this work.

Everyone is amazed by the arrival of the imperial [From.GetPrincessPrince], [From.GetHerHis] [From.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] highness [From.GetDynName]. Not that [From.GetSheHe] has not been expected – the court in [Root.Capital.GetName] has been busy with the preparations for weeks – no, they are simply astounded by the grandeur of [From.GetHerHis] procession. While those standing close to you begin to whisper about the silk banners and the gleaming armor of the imperial soldiers, you have your sight trained on the intricately decorated litter approaching, holding your future [From.GetHusbandWife].\n\n[From.GetPrincessPrince] [From.GetFirstName] does not wait for the servants to open the litter door. [From.GetSheHeCap] gets out on [From.GetHerHis] own and strides towards you, no hesitation slowing [From.GetHerHis] step. As you meet [From.GetHerHis] steady gaze, it is clear that you are looking at a [From.GetManWoman] who will either become your strongest ally, or your most dangerous enemy.

Everyone is amazed by the arrival of the imperial [From.GetPrincessPrince], [From.GetHerHis] [From.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] highness [From.GetDynName]. Not that [From.GetSheHe] has not been expected – the court in [Root.Capital.GetName] has been busy with the preparations for weeks – no, they are simply astounded by the grandeur of [From.GetHerHis] procession. While those standing close to you begin to whisper about the silk banners and the gleaming armor of the imperial soldiers, you have your sight trained on the intricately decorated litter approaching, holding your future [From.GetHusbandWife].\n[From.GetPrincessPrince] [From.GetFirstName]'s face shines like a sun as [From.GetSheHe] steps down to greet you. [From.GetHerHisCap] gaze wanders across the crowd, acknowledging each and every courtier in your personal retinue, before locking eyes with you. Murmurs of approval confirm that you are not alone to be struck by the [From.GetPrincessPrince]'s charm.

Everyone is amazed by the arrival of the imperial [From.GetPrincessPrince], [From.GetHerHis] [From.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] highness [From.GetDynName]. Not that [From.GetSheHe] has not been expected – the court in [Root.Capital.GetName] has been busy with the preparations for weeks – no, they are simply astounded by the grandeur of [From.GetHerHis] procession. While those standing close to you begin to whisper about the silk banners and the gleaming armor of the imperial soldiers, you have your sight trained on the intricately decorated litter approaching, holding your future [From.GetHusbandWife].\n\nIt is no mere [From.GetManWoman] who steps down from the litter, but a creature of pure, ethereal grace. [From.GetSheHeCap] does not walk across the courtyard to meet you – [From.GetSheHe] glides. Awe mingles with a tiny sliver of dread as you look upon [From.GetHerHis] emotionless face. How has a [Root.GetManWoman] like you come to deserve such a noble [From.GetBrideGroom]?
§Y[imperial_marriage_spouse_1.GetTitledFirstName]§! and §Y[imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetTitledFirstName]§! are now married.\n

My [GetFromRelation], [From.GetTitledFirstName], has now married the imperial [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetPrincessPrince] [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetDynName]. The grand ceremony and the foreign [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetPrincessPrince] will be the talk of the realm for many years to come.
I wish them happiness and many healthy children.

The heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has graciously accepted your gift. [person_sent_as_tribute.GetImpressionOfTribute]. \n\nThe generosity of the [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] dynasty will not be forgotten.
I can see how my choice of tribute might seem miscalculated...

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has generously granted your request. A royal seal has been delivered denoting the status of the [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetFullName] as a favored state for imperial goods.
Splendid!

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has graciously fulfilled your wish. War Engineer [cathayan_siege_engineer_1.GetDynName] along with two of [cathayan_siege_engineer_1.GetHerHis] apprentices, [cathayan_siege_engineer_2.GetDynName] and [cathayan_siege_engineer_3.GetDynName], have been dispatched to your court.
Send my most sincere gratitude to the [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle].
I will put them to use immediately!
Assign all currently open Commander Slots to the Siege Engineers - if not enough Commander Slots are available, fire currently appointed Commanders to make room for them!
Assign all currently open Commander Slots to the Siege Engineers.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has graciously received your relief expedition and put their supplies to good use. The generosity of the [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] dynasty will not be forgotten.
Anything to please the [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle].

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] agrees with your wise judgement that [cathayan_invasion_target.GetFullName] threatens the harmony of the world. The Jade Legions of the [From.Offmap.GetFullName] are already marching out of the Great Bastion.

Following the wicked lies of [cathayan_invasion_instigator.GetBestName], the [From.Offmap.GetName] has declared war upon us with the intent of shattering our glorious realm! [From.Offmap.Ruler.Culture.GetName] armies are already marching towards [cathayan_invasion_target.PrimaryTitle.GetName], we must prepare for a long and bloody struggle.

Following the sage advice of [cathayan_invasion_instigator.GetBestName], the [From.Offmap.GetName] has declared war upon [cathayan_invasion_target.GetFullName] with the intent of shattering the [cathayan_invasion_target.PrimaryTitle.GetAdjective] [cathayan_invasion_target.PrimaryTitle.GetTier]! [From.Offmap.Ruler.Culture.GetName] armies are already marching towards [cathayan_invasion_target.PrimaryTitle.GetName], and it seems possible that this spells the end for [cathayan_invasion_target.GetTitledFirstName]'s great realm.
Just as planned...
We shall humbly assist the Emperor in this endeavor!

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has graciously fulfilled your wish. A wondrous artifact of expert [From.Offmap.Ruler.Culture.GetName] craftsmanship will be bestowed upon you for safekeeping.
Truly a magnificent item!

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetShortCathayanEmperorName] has decided to grant the house of [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] the greatest honor. [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetHerHisCap] niece, the [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] Princess [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetFirstName], will become the bride of [imperial_marriage_spouse_1.GetTitledFirstName].

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has graciously accepted your offer of supplying [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetHerHis] army with magnificent steeds.
May they trample your enemies!

[offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetMediumCathayanEmperorName] has shut the gates of the Great Bastion and halted all trade along the roads east. This cannot stand. [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetSheHeCap] starves not only the merchants of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] but my own lands as well. One way or another, the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress] must open those gates...
War is the only way this shall be resolved!
The roads east are already ours. We need only 'convince' the caravan masters of it.
We must proceed carefully - let us negotiate first.
On second thought, this might not be the best idea...

When [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] shut the gates and halted the caravans on the roads east, [From.GetTitledName] would not accept it and marched to open them by force. The [From.Culture.GetName] army has beaten the Jade Legions of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] under [offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitledFirstName].\nThe Son of Heaven is most displeased, but pressed by the court, [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetSheHe] has had no choice but to open the gates to the caravans once more.
The roads east are open... but at what cost?

When [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] shut the gates and halted the caravans on the roads east, [From.GetTitledName] would not accept it and marched to open them by force. But the [From.Culture.GetName] army was no match for the Jade Legions of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] under [offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitledFirstName].\nThe Son of Heaven is well pleased with the victory, and the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] stays shut.
It seems even a dormant dragon is a dangerous one...

When [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] shut the gates and halted the caravans on the roads east, [From.GetTitledName] would not accept it. Through [From.GetHerHis] hold over the wealth of the roads, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has driven the caravan masters back to their posts, and the flood of goods is felt all the way to [offmap_cathay.GetShortName], to the fury of the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress].\nUnable to stem the tide, the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress] has had no choice but to open the gates once more.
And now commerce and trade return to the East.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\nThe heavenly [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], has decreed that the Empire focus its efforts on the [offmap_cathay.GetRandomCathayanFocus].\nHence we do not have time to negotiate allowing your traders to return. I am sure you can understand why and respect this decision.
I shall not press the matter...
Then war it must be!

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\nIn exchange for opening the gates of the Great Bastion to the caravans of the roads east, the heavenly [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] demands that you [GetCathayanForceOpenDemand].\nI am sure you can see how this will benefit both our realms, and I trust you to choose wisely.
That sounds like a reasonable request.
I was a fool to think this was possible!
These demands are an outrage! We will open the roads by force!

The gates of Cathay are open once more! [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] and [From.GetTitledName] have come to terms: the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress] will let the caravans pass, and all [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetSheHe] asked was for [From.GetTitledFirstName] to [From.GetCathayanForceOpenDemandCathay].\nThe [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress] might have preferred to stay behind the Great Bastion, but whispers from the east say even [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHis] closest advisors are pleased with this peaceful end.
I am a wonderful negotiator.
I am impressed this ended without bloodshed.
I'm glad my tribute is deemed decent.
I aim to please!
My [person_sent_as_tribute.GetRootRelation] will be missed.
[FromFrom.GetSheHeCap] will be missed.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe heavenly [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName], is most sorry to hear about the death of [FromFrom.GetTitledName], your [FromFrom.GetCathayanCharacterRole], and offers you [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetHerHis] most sincere condolences.
Your offering has been received. The [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle] does not thank mortals, but [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetSheHe] will remember who gave and who did not.
Your pledge has been heard. Henceforth you are counted among the servants of [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitledName], and your service will be watched.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting].\n\nIt has come to the attention of the Celestial Court that [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName], whom the heavenly [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] sent to serve you in good faith, has died by your hand. The Dragon Throne does not forget such insults.
This option is available because you hold an §Yend of the roads east§! and §Y25% of the wealth§! of one of them.
You will force open trade along the roads east, to the fury of the §Y[offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§!.
You will negotiate with the §Y[offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§! to open trade along the roads east.

If you are victorious, the §Y[offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§! will open its borders and you will be §Gfavoured in trade along the roads east§!. If you are defeated, it will cost you §Rmonthly prestige and grace§!.
Does NOT have a Cathayan Strategist
Does NOT have Siege Engineers from Cathay

The §Y[Root.Offmap.GetFullName]§! is famed for its schools of engineering and war. You can request three of its Siege Engineers to come and serve as commanders in your sieges. Each of them has the §YWay of the Leopard§! trait (Siege Speed: §G50%§!).
Has NOT sent relief to Cathay in the last 5 years
Bow before the Dragon Throne and pay tribute to the §Y[Root.Offmap.GetFullName]§!. A tributary earns §GGrace§! and the protection of the Jade Viceroy, at the price of part of its income.
You become a §YTributary§! of the §Y[offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§!.
Has a realm county bordering the realm of the §Y[offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitle]§!\n
Has a realm county bordering a tributary of the §Y[offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§!\n

Ask the §Y[Root.Offmap.GetFullName]§! to march on a great realm near its borders. The §Y[Root.Offmap.Governor.GetTitle]§! will declare war to tear lands from the target and force it to bow as a §YTributary§! of the Dragon Throne. The Jade Legions only march on §YKings or Emperors§! ruling at least §Y40 Counties§!, as anything less is beneath them.
Is NOT the head of a faith
Has NOT asked the Dragon to march in the last 20 years
The §Y[offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitle]§! declares war on the chosen ruler, to force them to submit to the Dragon Throne.
Force Open Cathay

The §Y[Root.Offmap.GetFullName]§! has shut the Great Bastion and halted trade along the roads east. Force its gates open: by war, by mastery of the roads east, or by talks with the §Y[Root.Offmap.Governor.GetTitle]§!.
Nobody is already forcing Cathay open
You will choose how to open the §Y[offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§!: defeat it in §Ywar§!, hold an §Yend of the roads east§! and §Y25%§! of the wealth of one of the roads, or §Ynegotiate§! a treaty.
[offmap_cathay.GetShortName] has shut the Great Bastion and halted trade along the roads east. This cannot stand: the trade must flow!
